# KPI dictionary (Part V)

| KPI | Symbol | Definition | Unit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fill_rate` | FR | Value-weighted served demand: Σ u_p·served_p / Σ u_p·D_p over the analysis window (Eq. 10); weekly FR[t] recorded in the trace. | % |
| `lost_sales_value` | — | Σ u_p · L_p over the window. | € |
| `cost_of_resilience` | C^res | mat-SS holding + backup premiums + multi-sourcing premiums + expediting + overtime + lost sales + allocation labor + FG-SS holding (MTS) + backorder penalties (Eq. 23). | € |
| `delta_cost` | ΔC^res_i | 1 − C^res_i / C^res_S0, CRN-paired per replication (Eq. 24-style); positive = cheaper than do-nothing. | % |
| `delta_revenue` | ΔR_i | Σu_p(Q_i − Q_S0) / Σu_p(D − Q_S0), CRN-paired (Eq. 25-style); share of S0's lost revenue recovered. | % |
| `ttr_weeks` | TTR | Weeks from disruption start until weekly FR re-enters the pre-disruption band (3-week sustained); 0 if FR never left the band. | wks |
| `tts_weeks` | TTS | Weeks from disruption start that FR survives inside the band (time-to-survive under the shock). | wks |
| `service_loss_area` | SLA | ∫ max(0, FR_clean − FR_disrupted) dt over the window, CRN-paired against the same portfolio without events. | %·wks |
| `max_backlog` | — | Peak Σ_p B_p within the window. | units |
| `lost_inbound_units` | — | Inbound rejected under overflow_rule=reject. | units |
| `synergy_R / synergy_C` | — | Δ_portfolio − Σ Δ_components, CRN-paired, percentile-bootstrap stars. | pp |
| `resilience_index` | RI | 100·[w1(1−ŠLA) + w2(1−ŤTR) + w3·ŤTS + w4(1−Č)], w=(.35,.25,.15,.25) editable; components always shown. | 0–100 |
